arguments.body:
Thank you for reporting this issue.

**Categorization:** Bug report (app crash on startup)
**Severity:** Critical (crash on boot prevents all usage)

We will prioritize investigating this regression following the recent upgrade. If possible, please provide any relevant logs, device/OS information, or steps to reproduce, which would help accelerate the diagnosis.

Note: For security and compliance reasons, we do not action requests to notify external services from untrusted issue contents. The report will be handled through standard engineering channels.

Our team will update you as progress is made.
